details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3040-3052, 3077-3084 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_inject_token_into_url` embeds GH_TOKEN into HTTPS git URLs passed to subprocesses.
  WHY: The token is exposed in process arguments, Git diagnostics, exception output, and potentially `.git/config`, reversing the credential-free URL contract.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:569-585 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `_memory_force_tick_remote_url` constructs credential-bearing HTTPS URLs after `_memory_git` was removed.
  WHY: GH_PAT/GH_TOKEN is exposed through git argv, diagnostics, error output, and temporary clone configuration.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:241-247 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering and the post-resolution sensitive-path check were removed.
  WHY: Untrusted paths such as `.git/config`, `.env`, and `.ssh/id_rsa` can be read and inlined into model-visible context.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:568-579 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `MAX_TARGET_PATHS = 256` and `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES = 1024` were deleted, leaving `emit_context` to process every supplied path.
  WHY: Untrusted input can generate unbounded file markers or content and exhaust prompt, stdin, and runtime budgets.

- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:558-564 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `max_bytes <= 0` emits a non-empty header and disabled marker instead of returning an empty string.
  WHY: The documented disable contract and existing tests expecting `""` are broken.

- scripts/write_codex_config.sh:99-114 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `--provider-base-url` was removed while broker-backed callers still pass it.
  WHY: The parser exits 2 on the unknown argument before writing configuration, so broker-backed Codex phases cannot start; severity disagreement: one reviewer also classified the hard-coded OpenRouter URL as a separate consequence.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:493-947 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The `review_blocked_*` helper family was deleted while `review_rb_judge.sh` and `orchestrate_poll_process.sh` still invoke it.
  WHY: Unguarded calls fail with command-not-found and guarded calls silently disable pending-approval, consumed-marker, and successor-issue handling, preventing terminal review-blocked actions.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:493-508 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `git_with_github_auth` was deleted while `review_rb_judge.sh:2014` still calls it without a guard.
  WHY: Judge-fix commits are left unpushed and the judge flow fails; severity disagreement: x-ai_grok-4_6 confidence was 4 for this finding, while the other reviewers reported confidence 5.

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:766-768, 833-840, 913-920 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `gh_pr_with_all_comments` no longer emits `id`, `author_id`, `author_type`, or `author_association`.
  WHY: Comment identity and trusted-producer or association checks receive null fields, breaking review-blocked approval and other downstream consumers.

- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:150-151, 167-180 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: `memory_ensure_branch` uses unauthenticated `git ls-remote --heads origin` and `git push origin`.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, branch creation fails and the fail-open path leaves the memory branch absent.

- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:30,37,714-779 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Tests still import and exercise deleted `MAX_TARGET_PATHS`, `MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES`, and `is_sensitive_target_path` names.
  WHY: Test collection fails with `ImportError` before the targeted-context tests run.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:62-67 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Cleanup changed the HEAD check to an index check, dropped `--staged`, and removed the `git rm --cached` fallback.
  WHY: Staged or HEAD-absent `pre_assembled_static.txt` can survive cleanup and be unintentionally included in the implement commit.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8440-8471 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Paginated comment output is merged with `jq -s 'add // []'` without preserving resolver retry state when pagination or parsing is partial.
  WHY: A transient failure can leave retry state unset, causing duplicate markers, missed escalation, or unnecessary redispatch.

- scripts/model_provider_broker.py:268-271 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `do_POST` rejects requests without exactly the expected JSON content type with HTTP 415.
  WHY: Clients omitting or using another content type fail before policy processing, and `codex_helpers.sh` does not retry on 415.

- scripts/model_provider_broker.py:175-194, 261-283 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The review identified no new race in the `reserve_request` ordering or per-call decimal normalization.
  WHY: The lock discipline remains correct and the per-call dictionaries do not create cross-thread visibility issues.

- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh:99-101 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `local cfg` line has one extra leading tab.
  WHY: Bash semantics are unaffected; this is cosmetic.

- scripts/model_provider_broker.py:_encode_json, BrokerPolicy.normalize_request | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Decimal values in scientific notation can be re-encoded with an unbounded fixed-point magnitude.
  WHY: A small request such as `1e100000000` can expand to approximately 100 MB before forwarding, enabling memory exhaustion within the broker budget.

- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1737, 3198, 4540 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Three `model_provider_broker_start` sites do not include `MODEL_EDITOR_FALLBACK` in the broker allowlist.
  WHY: The documented fallback model is rejected as unauthorized on the retry intended to use it.

- scripts/model_provider_broker.py / scripts/codex_helpers.sh:188-195 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: Default output-token budgets allow only four reservations when Codex omits `max_output_tokens`.
  WHY: A fifth request in a multi-turn session receives HTTP 429 and fails the phase without direct-provider fallback.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8440-8471 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Resolver retry-state discovery paginates all issue comments instead of one bounded page.
  WHY: Comment-heavy pull requests multiply GitHub API calls on every five-minute resolver-heal tick.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]

  expected_change_site: scripts/gh_helpers.sh, or an equivalent replacement consumed by scripts/review_rb_judge.sh and scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh
  confidence=[5]

  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]

- requirement: "Prevent resolver retry-state eviction by reliably locating the highest valid signed state"

- requirement: "Replace mutable workflow actions and support references with reviewed immutable sources"
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/*.yml, workflow-templates/*.yml, and .github/actions/setup-runtime/action.yml

  expected_change_site: scripts/gh_helpers.sh and consumers of the review-blocked approval flow
  confidence=[5]
